task.title: Add batch outreach and trainable instructions to Renzo
task.description:
Add two features to the existing Renzo app. Keep ALL existing functionality. ADD ONLY:

1. BATCH OUTREACH: Add 'Batch Outreach' nav item. View shows a textarea prompt input and a Generate button. User types natural language like 'reach out to all contacts with contracts expiring soon'. App filters contacts using simple keyword matching (contract/expiry/expire -> check contractExpiry field; invoice/overdue -> check invoiceAmount; not contacted/overdue -> check lastContactDate). For each matching contact, generates an AI message using the existing generateAiMessage function. Shows progress 'Generating 1 of 5...'. Adds all results to the outreach queue. Shows completion summary.

2. TRAINABLE INSTRUCTIONS: In Settings view, add a section 'My Outreach Rules' with: a textarea to type a new rule, an Add Rule button, a list of existing rules each with a delete button. Rules stored in localStorage as array under key 'renzo_rules'. These rules get appended to every AI message generation prompt as 'Follow these rules: [rule1], [rule2]...'
task.project_vision: Renzo is a frontend-only AI outreach tool. Single HTML file. localStorage. No backend. Add batch outreach and trainable instructions.

blocking_issues: HTML structure incomplete - closing style tag and remaining HTML missing
No keyboard navigation implemented for modals - users cannot tab through or escape
Focus trap missing in modals - keyboard users will tab behind modal
No ARIA labels on icon-only buttons (close button uses × symbol only)
Modal close button lacks accessible label - screen readers cannot identify purpose
Contact cards marked as cursor:pointer but no keyboard interaction (click handler likely JS-only)
Form validation errors not announced to screen readers - missing aria-live regions
Priority badges use color only for meaning - no text alternative for colorblind users

Modal animation conflict: `.modal` has `display: none` with `opacity: 0` transition, but `display` is not animatable. The modal will appear instantly then fade, breaking the animation. Use `visibility: hidden` instead of `display: none`.
Search input background SVG has unencoded characters: The `<svg>` in `background-image` needs proper URL encoding. Current format will fail in some browsers.
Incomplete media query at line 768: `.insights-grid` rule is cut off mid-property (`grid-`), causing CSS parse error.
Modal accessibility: No focus trap implementation visible. Users can tab to elements behind modal, breaking keyboard navigation.
Contact cards lack keyboard interaction: `cursor: pointer` on `.contact-card` but no keyboard event handling (Enter/Space) for accessibility.
Loading spinner animation uses `transform` without setting `transform-box` property, may cause issues in Safari with inline SVG contexts.
Incomplete CSS rule: `.modal-content` has incomplete `max` property that will cause parsing errors
Missing closing brace for `.modal-content` media query rule
